properties.description: What a client of the MCP server sees while the Anchor node type is going, with deprecation::REGISTRY as built (its first real entry), every call over the protocol: describe_schema marks Anchor `deprecated` with the what-to-do and lists it under `deprecations` with dec:anchor-retire-or-implement (the listed item unmarked), and the what-to-do names served tools (add_epoch, snapshot_before_change); create_node of an Anchor still works and answers exactly as the last release did but for `deprecation_notice`, and get_node and scan_nodes of it carry the notice too; DriftEvent's hint no longer names the Anchor and says it DEPENDS_ON the drifted Artifact, which a recorded reconcile_artifacts really draws, and Anchor's hint no longer claims DriftEvents reference it; nine common reads that never touch Anchor carry no notice. Written first: all four tests failed on main at 959436d80; the listed-item assertion failed on 3a24c4daa.
properties.name: tests/the_unused_anchor_type_is_announced_for_removal.rs
